## Change / 变更

Describe the behavior and affected contract.

## Verification / 验证

Commands, exact revision and actual results. Distinguish unrun tests from failures and real-game evidence from generated inputs.

## Compatibility and recovery / 兼容与恢复

Describe format/API/dependency changes, preserved behavior and recovery when applicable.

## Review / 审查

- [ ] Code, tests and bilingual user-facing content agree.
- [ ] Source rights and dependency notices are retained.
- [ ] No game assets, credentials, saves or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Unverified game behavior is not described as available capability.
